RG-e403dcb056.description: Function uses a mutable default argument
RG-e403dcb056.rationale: The same mutable object is reused across calls, which can leak state between invocations.

LLM-092420dec1.description: Uses a mutable default argument causing shared state across calls, leading to cross‑call data leakage.
LLM-092420dec1.rationale: The default dict is created once at function definition time; every invocation mutates the same object, so data from one call persists into subsequent calls, breaking isolation and potentially exposing sensitive information.

LLM-18b6eb1fcb.description: Uses a mutable default argument causing shared state across calls and crashes on unhashable values
LLM-18b6eb1fcb.rationale: The default dict is created once at function definition, so successive calls mutate the same cache, leading to unexpected persistence and potential race conditions; also non‑hashable values raise TypeError
